# Mauro CI

> Shared GitHub Actions workflows and composite actions for MauroDataMapper
> repositories.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): repository purpose, contents, and basic reuse examples.
- [Agent integration guidance](AGENTS.md): portable instructions for coding
  agents integrating these workflows and actions into a consuming repository.

## Reusable workflows

- [Gradle test](.github/workflows/gradle-test.yml)
- [Gradle publish](.github/workflows/gradle-publish.yml)
- [Docker build validation](.github/workflows/docker-build.yml)
- [Docker Hub publish](.github/workflows/docker-publish.yml)
- [MegaLinter](.github/workflows/megalinter.yml)
- [JUnit report](.github/workflows/junit-report.yml)
- [SARIF upload](.github/workflows/sarif-upload.yml)
- [Zulip notification](.github/workflows/zulip-notify.yml)

## Composite actions

- [Setup Java and Gradle](actions/setup-gradle-java/action.yml)
- [Setup Docker Buildx](actions/setup-docker-buildx/action.yml)
- [Prepare MegaLinter](actions/prepare-megalinter/action.yml)

- [Workflow security checks](.github/workflows/security-checks.yml)
